summary: The author prompts Opus 5.5 and Fable 5 with 'Build an ultra-realistic flight simulator' and demonstrates screen recordings of the resulting playable flight simulation experiences.
summaryEn: Interactive Flight Simulator Comparison Built by Opus 5.5

post.originalText:
I gave Fable 5 and Opus 5.5 the exact same challenge:

“Build an ultra-realistic flight simulator.”

Same prompt. Same starting point.

Opus 5.5 took it somewhere else entirely.

The gap in what these models can turn into a playable experience is getting wild. https://t.co/wbaqhS7PUJ
